correctness.rationale: The calculation substitutes the exact Table 1 values into the source's displayed Example 6.2 reproduction number. With equal delays and equal pre-production death rates, the source formula reduces algebraically to a single exponential times \(1-2\xi/7\). Exact rational arithmetic gives the stated prefactors, and high-precision evaluation leaves all four captioned cases above one. The derivative with respect to the latency fraction has the opposite sign from the Figure 2 labels.

value.rationale: The numerical section is presented as confirmation that increasing intracellular delay and changing the latent-infection fraction can move the model across the infection threshold. Under the source's own formula and table, neither displayed experiment crosses the threshold, and the latency-fraction effect has the opposite direction. This materially changes the interpretation of both figures and is directly useful for reproducibility.
